text:
anya - AE: Customer NeuraHealth asks if PrivateLink will preserve client source IPs for their logging. Also wants a one-line POC cost estimate.

raj - solutions eng: PrivateLink ENIs will present traffic from the ENI IPs unless you avoid SNAT. For true client IP preservation you need either: 1) route-to-ENI without SNAT (preferred), or 2) 1:1 NAT translation that maps internal client IPs. Note: peering/TGW often preserve src-ip by default if routing not SNATted.

hannah - netops: Firewall snippet to paste: 
- proto: tcp
  ports: [443]
  dest_cidr: ["10.100.200.0/28"]
  description: "Allow Redwood Private ENIs"
# To preserve src-ip: ensure no SNAT between client subnet and ENI route table.

li - security: If their DLP does TLS inspect and terminates TLS, client cert chains won't reach us 12 breaks mTLS. Recommend a bypass for our ENI CIDRs for streams & auth. We'll add this to questionnaire.

anya - AE: POC cost ask (5-day, ~3TB): raj can you give a 1-line estimate we can show?

raj - solutions eng: Ballpark: PrivateLink endpoints (~$0.01-.02/hr) + data processing ~$0.01/GB => ~ $30 for 3TB + a few dollars in endpoint hours. TGW could be cheaper at scale but slower to stand up.

infra-bot: Created ticket NH-POC-9001 and attached stub docs.
